quote.text: If you look on wealth as a thing to be valued your imaginary poverty will cause you torment.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood:
    • Just as wealth does not define our inner virtue, so too should we guide our children to value integrity and character over material accumulation.
    • Seeing abundance in moments of everyday life nurtures the heart of a child, teaching them that true richness lies in love, compassion, and personal growth.
  • Leadership:
    • A wise leader understands that the pursuit of wealth for its own sake can distract from the higher purpose of serving and inspiring others.
    • By valuing authenticity and virtue over transient gains, leaders can foster enduring trust and resilience within their teams and communities.
  • Product Management:
    • In managing products, recognizing that success is not solely measured by financial metrics can lead to more meaningful innovation and customer satisfaction.
    • Focusing on the inherent value of ideas and user experience reminds us that lasting impact comes from enriching lives rather than chasing ephemeral wealth.
